_about.what: Provenance of every SFX file (contract §0.12). Procedural synthesis, numpy only, no models.
_about.how: audio-src/sfx/synth.py renders generator(rng=np.random.default_rng(seed), **params), then DC-block, trim/fade (one-shots), loudness normalisation per category, OGG Vorbis.
